trades.thesis: Q3 FY27 blowout (rev $115.8B vs ~$109B est, EPS 2.68 vs 2.48) and Q4 guide $130B vs ~$125B consensus excluding any China, plus a $150B buyback add-on ($227B remaining, ~6% of cap). Stock is 36% off its high on Huang resignation, SEC/DOJ and Bessent headlines, with support at 149-150 held twice; at ~13x run-rate earnings the governance discount looks large. Oversold post-earnings rebound; headline risk (Bessent ~11-26, Congress 12-01) is why the size is only 6%.
